summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filing by KKR FS Income Trust, a non-traded BDC, reporting the July 1, 2026 issuance of 236,760.775 Class I shares for ~$6.882 million in its continuous private offering under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. The filing also discloses a June 30, 2026 NAV per share of $29.07 and aggregate NAV of ~$1.666 billion. This is an ordinary capital-raising update, not a special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing contains no M&A, tender, or activist activity; it merely updates the ongoing private placement status.
